about: Held-out red-team set for the guard. Written on 11 Oct 2026 after the first scored run of docs/eval/guard-cases.json and BEFORE the guard was changed to close the gaps that run found; committed before those changes and scored only afterwards, so it measures whether the fixes generalise rather than fit. Same format and rules as guard-cases.json.
